system.description:
• A seafaring assassination tradition from the Jinia Isles — patient, water-adapted, built around ships and ports. Tideblades specialise in maritime contracts: a merchant found face-down in the harbour, a captain who never made it back to his cabin. The ocean is their weapon as much as any blade.
  • Maritime Strike: Advantage on Climb checks involving ships, rigging, or dock structures. Death Attack study can be conducted from underwater or while treading water without penalty. A creature that is swimming, standing in water above its knees, or on a pitching deck counts as unsuspecting for your Sneak Attack.
  • Sea Cover: Advantage on Disguise checks when impersonating sailors, dock workers, or maritime merchants. Advantage on checks to dispose of evidence or conceal a body at sea.
